title: Build retry events
description: Retry decisions, retries and retry chains sent by the pipeline-build-retry plugin as OTLP log events (sendEvents) to Loki.

list.name: namespace
list.label: Service namespace
list.description: service.namespace of the events: jenkins unless Events resource attributes replaces it.

list.name: env
list.label: Environment
list.description: deployment.environment.name from the plugin's Events resource attributes; All also shows events sent without it.

panels.title: Jobs using the plugin
panels.description: One row per job that has buildRetry, from each job's newest build_retry.job_config event in the dashboard's time range. Controllers send the full list hourly and one job's event when its settings change, only with Send configured jobs ticked. A job that loses buildRetry, is deleted or renamed drops out when its event arrives; one removed without its own event drops out at the next full list. Last sent is how long ago the row's event arrived; orange past 2 hours means that controller stopped sending the list, and the row is its last known state.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.job_config" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job"

panels.title: Decisions
panels.description: End decisions sent for builds of jobs with buildRetry, in the time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" [$__range]))

panels.title: Retries queued
panels.description: Decisions that queued a retry.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_outcome="queued" [$__range]))

panels.title: Would retry (dry run)
panels.description: Decisions that would have queued a retry if dryRun were off.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_outcome="dry-run" [$__range]))

panels.title: Chains recovered
panels.description: Retry chains whose last build passed.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.chain_ended" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_chain_end="recovered" [$__range]))

panels.title: Chains exhausted
panels.description: Retry chains that used every retry and still failed.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.chain_ended" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_chain_end="exhausted" [$__range]))

panels.title: Retries cancelled
panels.description: Waiting retries cancelled because a newer build started (abortPrevious).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.retry_cancelled" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" [$__range]))

panels.title: Warnings
panels.description: Decisions sent at WARN severity: internal errors, invalid configuration, outcome error.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | severity_text="WARN" [$__range]))

panels.title: Recovery rate
panels.description: Recovered chains out of all ended chains (recovered, exhausted, stopped, cancelled).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.chain_ended" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_chain_end="recovered" [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.chain_ended" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" [$__range]))

panels.title: Decisions by outcome
panels.description: Each build's end decision, by what became of it.

targets.expr: sum by (build_retry_outcome) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Chain ends
panels.description: How retry chains ended over time.

targets.expr: sum by (build_retry_chain_end) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.chain_ended" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" [$__auto]))

panels.title: No-retry reasons
panels.description: Why builds were not retried (reason code before the colon).

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (build_retry_reason) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_outcome="no-retry" [$__range])))

panels.title: Retries queued per job
panels.description: Jobs that queued the most retries.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (ci_pipeline_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_outcome="queued" [$__range])))

panels.title: Would retry per job (dry run)
panels.description: Jobs in dry run that would have retried: the pilot view.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (ci_pipeline_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_outcome="dry-run" [$__range])))

panels.title: Abort kinds
panels.description: Aborted builds by how they were aborted (user, timeout, infra, unknown).

targets.expr: sum by (build_retry_abort_kind) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_abort_kind!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Triggered by
panels.description: What started the first build of each chain or single build.

targets.expr: sum by (build_retry_cause_kinds) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_retry_count="0" [$__range]))

panels.title: Results
panels.description: Build results the decisions saw.

targets.expr: sum by (ci_pipeline_run_result) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" [$__range]))

panels.title: Recovery rate per job
panels.description: Recovered chains out of ended chains, per job: how flaky each job is.

targets.expr: sum by (ci_pipeline_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.chain_ended" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_chain_end="recovered" [$__range])) / sum by (ci_pipeline_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.chain_ended" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" [$__range]))

panels.title: Attempts per chain
panels.description: Average builds per ended chain, per job (1 is the first build).

targets.expr: avg by (ci_pipeline_id) (avg_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.chain_ended" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | unwrap build_retry_attempts [$__range]))

panels.title: Minutes in retry builds
panels.description: Build time spent in retry builds (not the first build), per job.

targets.expr: sum by (ci_pipeline_id) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_retry_count!="0" | unwrap ci_pipeline_run_duration_ms [$__range])) / 60000

panels.title: Planned delay against actual wait
panels.description: For each started retry: the delay the decision set and the time from the parent's end to the retry's start.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.retry_started" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | unwrap build_retry_planned_delay_seconds [$__auto]))

avg(avg_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.retry_started" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | unwrap build_retry_waited_ms [$__auto])) / 1000

panels.title: Chain duration
panels.description: Time from a chain's first build start to its last build end.

targets.expr: max by (build_retry_chain_end) (max_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.chain_ended" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | unwrap build_retry_chain_duration_ms [$__auto])) / 1000

panels.title: Agent loss
panels.description: Decisions that saw a lost agent, by reason (OOMKilled is never retried).

targets.expr: sum by (build_retry_reason) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_agent_loss="true" [$__range]))

panels.title: Kubernetes termination reasons
panels.description: Termination reasons of the failed agents' containers.

targets.expr: sum by (build_retry_termination_reasons) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_termination_reasons!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Regexp gate problems
panels.description: Log scans that timed out, had an invalid pattern or could not read the log.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_scan_timed_out="true" [$__auto]))

sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_scan_pattern_error="true" [$__auto]))

sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_scan_io_error="true" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Retries blocked by never-retry
panels.description: Builds a never-retry pattern stopped from retrying, per job and pattern number (the pattern text is never sent).

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (ci_pipeline_id, build_retry_never_retry_pattern_index) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | build_retry_never_retry_matched="true" [$__range])))

panels.title: Warnings
panels.description: Decisions sent at WARN severity.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.decision" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job" | severity_text="WARN"

panels.title: Setting changes
panels.description: Changes to the retry switch (enabled) and to sendEvents, with who changed them.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="build_retry.switch_changed" | jenkins_url=~"$controller"

panels.title: Latest events
panels.description: Every event, newest first.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"$service", service_namespace="$namespace", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name=~"build_retry\\..*" | jenkins_url=~"$controller" | ci_pipeline_id=~"$job"
